name: Three Divine Commandments
description:
In a single combat, have #1 ally characters aside from Aeon ★ Aha become "Emanators of Elation," and each provide Aeon ★ Aha with #2 "Wishpower" through the effect when the turn begins
※ Her commands are pretty much commandments, aren't they?
hiddenDescription: In a single combat, have 3 ally characters aside from Aeon ★ Aha become "Emanators," and each provide Aeon ★ Aha with 1 "Wishpower" through the effect when the turn begins
